start: Member whose phone does not have MettleUp (never sent a workout to this watch)

user_sees: 'Your watch needs the MettleUp app on your phone.'
must_not: 'Start a workout on your phone' while the phone has no MettleUp

user_sees: 'Look at your phone to install MettleUp.'
The phone opens MettleUp's Play Store page
must_not: Nothing happens with no word on the watch

start: Member whose phone does not have MettleUp (never sent a workout to this watch); the phone does not answer

user_sees: 'Your phone did not answer. Try again.'
must_not: 'Look at your phone' when nothing opened

start: Member who used MettleUp on this phone before, then removed the phone app

user_sees: 'Start a workout on your phone' (the phone counts as having MettleUp because it once sent a workout)
must_not: A loop between the two screens

steps.action: Install MettleUp on the phone again
user_sees: The same screen, then the workout once one is started
must_not: 'Get MettleUp on your phone' after it is installed

start: Person who installed the watch app first; the phone is connected but has no MettleUp

user_sees: 'Your watch needs the MettleUp app on your phone.'
must_not: 'Start a workout on your phone' while the phone has no MettleUp

user_sees: 'Look at your phone to install MettleUp.'
The phone opens MettleUp's Play Store page
must_not: Nothing happens with no word on the watch

start: Person who installed the watch app first; the phone is connected but has no MettleUp; the phone does not answer

user_sees: 'Your phone did not answer. Try again.'
must_not: 'Look at your phone' when nothing opened

start: Person who installed the watch app first; the phone is connected but has no MettleUp; 'Open on phone' already tapped

user_sees: Within a few checks the watch shows 'Start a workout on your phone'
must_not: 'Get MettleUp on your phone' after it is installed

steps.action: Dim the watch screen while 'Get MettleUp' shows
user_sees: The button as an outline; a tap does nothing until bright
must_not: A tap while dim sends a second request
